preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= k_i <= 10**18 for n_i, k_i in [(int(n), int(k)) for n, k in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]])
preconditions.description: Each test case consists of integers n_i and k_i where 1 ≤ n_i ≤ 10^9 and 1 ≤ k_i ≤ 10^18.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == 'YES' and ' ' in stdout.splitlines()[i]) or stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == 'NO' for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, output is either 'YES m' (where m is an integer) or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i].strip().split()[0] == 'YES' and 0 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip().split()[1]) <= n_i) or stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == 'NO' for i, (n_i, _) in enumerate([(int(n), int(k)) for n, k in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the integer m (log2 of the side length of the squares in the path) must satisfy 0 ≤ m ≤ n_i.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == 'YES' and (k_i - (2**(2*n_i) - 1)) <= (2**(2*(n_i - m)) - 1)) or stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == 'NO' for i, (n_i, k_i) in enumerate([(int(n), int(k)) for n, k in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the number of operations k_i must be feasible given the path side length m, i.e., k_i must be at least the minimum operations required to split the square down to side length 2^m and at most the total possible operations (2^(2*n_i) - 1).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == 'NO' and k_i > (2**(2*n_i) - 1)) or (stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == 'YES' and k_i <= (2**(2*n_i) - 1)) for i, (n_i, k_i) in enumerate([(int(n), int(k)) for n, k in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]]))
postconditions.description: If k_i exceeds the total possible operations (2^(2*n_i) - 1), the answer must be 'NO'. Otherwise, it must be 'YES' if feasible.
